records.no_procurement: Nothing from the request or planning stage is linked.
records.no_tender: No tender review has been raised for this procurement.
records.no_deviations: No deviations were raised on this procurement.
records.no_compliance: No compliance checks have been run.

audit.subtitle: Every action, who took it, when, and what changed

audit.empty: No audit events for this record.

documents.title: Documents
documents.subtitle: One register, linked wherever it applies — never uploaded twice
documents.not_linked: This document is not linked to anything yet.
documents.acknowledgement_required: This document must be acknowledged before it is relied on.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.subtitle: Everything waiting for a decision, across the module

products.subtitle: The same items Finance values and Manufacturing builds with — described here for the warehouse.

meaning_of.RECALLED: Subject to a recall; cannot be used or released.
meaning_of.IN_TRANSIT: Stock in an in-transit location, between two places.
meaning_of.EXPIRED: Available stock in a lot past its expiry date.
meaning_of.RESERVED: Available stock held for a specific order.

trace_public.title: Produce traceability
trace_public.from_growers: Part of this produce was grown by contracted growers.
trace_public.withdrawn: This lot has been withdrawn. Please do not eat it; return it to where you bought it.
trace_public.scan_label: Scan to see where it was grown

carbon.title: Carbon registry
carbon.subtitle: Carbon projects with a registry: listing, monitoring periods and data, issuances, the buffer, retirements and transfers.
carbon.no_api: Registries such as Verra and Gold Standard take submissions through their own portals and an accredited validation/verification body — there is no submission API, so nothing here is sent to a registry. Keep this record in step with the registry, and use the export package for the submission and the verifier.
carbon.buffer_hint: Share of each issuance the registry withholds in its non-permanence buffer pool.
carbon.buffer_t_hint: Blank: worked out from the buffer %.
carbon.export_hint: A zip with the project summary (PDF), monitoring data per period (CSV), the issuance ledger and every document.
carbon.no_projects: No carbon projects recorded. Record one under Weather & environment first.

residues.title: Residues & MRLs
residues.subtitle: Each lot against the maximum residue limits of the markets it is for. A lot over a market’s MRL, sprayed with an active banned there, or (where the market asks) untested, does not ship there without an authorised override.
residues.inherited: from the crop or the defaults
residues.default_limit_note: * the market’s default limit (no specific MRL for this active and crop).
residues.risks_subtitle: Actives applied this season whose withholding period ends close to (or after) the planned harvest, or that are banned in a target market: sample these blocks before picking.
residues.no_risks: Nothing close to harvest needs testing.
residues.starter_warning: Rows marked "starter" are an indicative starting point only. Verify every limit against the official databases (EU Pesticides Database, UK MRL database, South Africa’s Act 36 list, China GB 2763, US 40 CFR 180, Codex) or import the official lists.
residues.import_subtitle: Columns: active_ingredient, crop_code, market_code, mrl_mg_kg, source, effective_from. A row matching an existing limit (same active, crop, market and date) replaces it.
residues.source_hint: The database or regulation the limit comes from
residues.no_limits: No MRLs yet: install the starter set or import the official lists.
residues.restrictions_subtitle: A banned active applied to a lot’s crop stops it shipping to that market and is warned about when it is sprayed; a restricted one is a warning only.
residues.markets_subtitle: Where produce is sold, the countries each market covers (a load goes to the market of its destination country), and its rules.
residues.countries_hint: Two-letter country codes, separated by commas (NL, DE, BE)
residues.default_mrl_hint: Applies where no specific MRL is set (EU and UK: 0.01)
residues.markets_hint: Leave empty to use the crop’s markets, or the default target markets.
residues.crop_hint: Taken from the lot or crop when left empty
residues.override_prompt: Why may this load go to {market} despite the residue check? (Kept on record.)
residues.crop_markets_title: Markets each crop is grown for
residues.crop_markets_subtitle: Spray-time warnings and the lots harvested from a crop use these markets; none named means the default target markets.

certification.title: Certification checklists
certification.subtitle: Ready-made GLOBALG.A.P., SIZA and organic checklists, installed as your own scheme, with each farm’s self-assessment and the evidence its records already hold.
certification.points: {n} control points, {auto} evidenced automatically from farm records
certification.paraphrase_note: Control points are short summaries in our own words under the scheme’s reference numbers, to organise evidence; the official checklist and its guidance are what the auditor applies. Check the numbering against the edition you are audited on.
certification.edit_in_sheq: Edit your copy in SHEQ › Compliance schemes

pdf.subtitle: Self-assessment of {farm} on {date}, prepared by {by}
pdf.disclaimer: Control point summaries are paraphrased to organise evidence; the official checklist governs. Status is computed from farm records, linked documents and the assessor’s answers.

certification.not_adopted: This scheme is not adopted at this farm yet: adopt it to put its control points in the farm’s legal register, link documents and answer them.
certification.not_ready: Not ready: close the gaps below
certification.link_document: Link a document to its line in the SHEQ legal register.
certification.no_schemes: Install a checklist above to start the self-assessment.
certification.comment_hint: What shows it, or what is missing and what will be done

exports.title: Export documents
exports.subtitle: Per export load, the consignment and its document pack, generated into Document Management. An export load does not ship until its required documents exist for the consignment as it stands.
exports.authorities_note: Official phytosanitary certificates and certificates of origin are issued by the authorities (DALRRD ePhyto, the chamber of commerce). Mkhaya prepares their application data and the trader’s own documents.
exports.no_loads: No loads on this farm yet. Loads are picked on the packhouse’s Dispatch tab.
exports.codes_subtitle: PUC, PHC, FBO and exporter codes of this farm and its packhouses
exports.consignment_intro: Starts from the load: the customer as consignee, the pallets’ seal, and a line per lot. A change regenerates the documents already generated, as new versions.
exports.country_hint: Two-letter code (NL, GB, CN); decides the residue market too
exports.code_store_hint: Leave empty for the farm’s own production unit

pdf.phyto_note: Application data for the phytosanitary certificate. The certificate itself is issued by the national plant protection organisation (in South Africa, DALRRD through ePhyto) after inspection.
pdf.coo_note: Application data for the certificate of origin. The certificate itself is issued by the chamber of commerce or customs authority.
pdf.footer: Prepared with Mkhaya Agri from the consignment record. Check every figure before submission.

sales_pricing.label: Pricing
sales_pricing.basis_hint: Added to the futures price; negative for a discount.
sales_pricing.grade_premiums_hint: Per unit, e.g. WM1=0, WM2=-25, WM3=-60. A minus is a discount.

grain.title: Grain loads
grain.subtitle: Every truck from the field (or a silo) to the bin or the buyer: the weighbridge pairs its weighings, the grade sets the deductions, and the buyer’s statement is matched to our tickets.

f.item_hint: The item the silo holds it as (by mass).
f.destination_hint: Where it is delivered, e.g. VKB Reitz silo.
f.load_ref_hint: The combine or bin-cart load number, if the field keeps one.
f.grade_hint: Leave blank to grade from the readings.
f.ticket_hint: Leave blank: the bridge pairs by vehicle.
f.kind_hint: Leave blank to pair by size.
f.csv_hint: A header row: ticket, vehicle, date, net, moisture, grade, settled (or payable), price, amount.

grain.secret_once: Set this secret on the weighbridge’s software now. It is shown only once; a new one can be issued from Integrations.
grain.open_weighings_hint: First weighings waiting for their second, and weighed loads waiting to be graded.
grain.devices_hint: A tare more than {pct}% off the truck’s usual tare, or a gross over {max} kg, is flagged.
grain.no_devices: No weighbridge registered: weigh by hand, or register the bridge.
grain.flagged: Weighings that do not look right
grain.no_bins: This farm has no silo or store for grain yet: add one under Stock.
grain.recon_hint: Loads sent from the field and never weighed in, deliveries missing from the buyer’s statement, the same load twice, and statement lines with no load of ours.
grain.post_hint: Posts what the buyer pays as farm produce sales (debtors), per crop.
grain.contracts_hint: Grain contracts by load: delivered is what the buyer settled, or our settled mass until they have.
grain.log_load_intro: The load starts its ticket as it leaves. The weighbridge finds it by the vehicle; a load that never arrives shows as lost.
grain.capture_intro: Both weighings from the weighbridge slip. The grade and deductions follow from the readings and the grading standard.
grain.assess_intro: Both weighings are in: add the grader’s readings and where the load went, and it completes.
grain.weigh_intro: One pass over the bridge. The second weighing of the same truck is paired with the first.
grain.register_intro: The weighbridge posts each weighing to its own address with a secret, shown once.
grain.import_intro: The elevator’s statement as CSV. Each line is matched to our tickets by ticket number, else by truck, day and mass.

markets.title: Markets & hedging
markets.subtitle: Commodity prices per futures month, from your price feed or typed in; your hedges marked to market every day; and how much of each crop is still exposed to the price.

f.product_hint: Leave blank to use the crop’s name.
f.source_hint: Who published it, e.g. JSE commodity derivatives close.
f.contract_size_hint: SAFEX: maize 100 t, wheat, soya and sunflower 50 t.
f.entry_price_hint: For an option, the futures price when it was bought.
f.exit_price_hint: Futures: the price closed at. Option: the premium sold back at.
f.name: Name
f.default_crop: Crop (when the feed does not say)
f.default_product: Product (when the feed does not say)
f.delimiter_hint: Blank: found from the header row.
f.list_hint: Path to the list of rows, e.g. data.prices.
f.products_hint: One per line: the feed’s code = our product; crop code. e.g. WMAZ=White maize; MAIZE-W
f.secret_kept: Leave blank to keep the stored secret.

markets.no_prices: No prices for this crop yet: set up a price feed or type a price in.
markets.feeds_intro: JSE/SAFEX has no free API. Point a feed at the CSV or JSON your data vendor, broker or co-op publishes and map its columns; it is fetched every evening after the close, and failures are retried and shown under Integrations.
markets.records_only: This register keeps your positions and values them against the market feed. Nothing is sent to a broker or the exchange; your broker’s statement is the authority.
markets.no_marks: Not yet marked: no futures price for its month.
markets.valuation_note: Futures at the latest price for their month; options at intrinsic value (time value is not modelled).
markets.over_hedged: More is sold or hedged than the crop is expected to give.
markets.no_position: No grain crops, contracts or hedges.
markets.columns_hint: The column header (CSV), its position from 0, or the path in each JSON row. Only the price is required.
markets.guard: What the feed sends is data, never instructions: text is cleaned, and a row that reads like an instruction is kept and flagged.
